His eloquence also shines in politics and diplomacy.
en2: Master at winning hearts; his speeches inspire all to vow victory. His own skills may not be outstanding, but his troops' results rival any other. His eloquence excels in politics and diplomacy.

今から１０年ほど昔、グリムザク王国は「静かなる王」イル・ヴァンダが支配する、闇の王国であった。イル・ヴァンダは強い力と強い魔力を兼ね備えたダークエルフ族の英雄である。しかも好戦的なダークエルフの中では珍しく温厚で思慮深い人物であり、光の国々と協調する姿勢を示し、平和な世が訪れたかに見えた。しかし、美しい女魔道士・アルトゥーリアがこの地に現れ、イル・ヴァンダの目にとまり、国の大神官に抜擢されたときから事態は急変するのである。
enRaw: {"string": "About ten years ago, the Kingdom of Grimzak was a dark kingdom ruled by 'The Silent King,' Il-Vanda. Il-Vanda was a hero of the Dark Elf race, possessing both great strength and powerful magic. Moreover, unlike the typically warlike Dark Elves, he was known for his gentle and thoughtful nature, showing willingness to cooperate with the lands of light, and it seemed peace had finally arrived. However, the situation took a sudden turn when the beautiful female sorceress Arturia appeared in this land and caught Il-Vanda's eye, being appointed as the nation's High Priestess."}
en: About ten years ago, the Kingdom of Grimzak was a dark kingdom ruled by 'The Silent King,' Il-Vanda. Il-Vanda was a hero of the Dark Elf race, possessing both great strength and powerful magic. Moreover, unlike the typically warlike Dark Elves, he was known for his gentle and thoughtful nature, showing willingness to cooperate with the lands of light, and it seemed peace had finally arrived. However, the situation took a sudden turn when the beautiful female sorceress Arturia appeared in this land and caught Il-Vanda's eye, being appointed as the nation's High Priestess.
en2: Ten years ago, Grimzak Kingdom was ruled by 'Silent King' Il-Vanda, a gentle Dark Elf hero. Peace seemed near as he cooperated with light nations. But all changed when the sorceress Arturia appeared and was named High Priestess.

大陸暦２３６３年、四魔王の封印を解くことに成功したアルトゥーリアは、精神を支配したイル・ヴァンダに皇帝を名乗らせ、国号をグリムザク帝国と改める。そして封印されし邪神デルニソスの復活の鍵となる光の元首達を捕らえるべく、光の勢力に対して牙を剥くのであった。
enRaw: {"string":"In the year 2363 of the Continental Calendar, Arturia succeeded in breaking the seals on the Four Demon Lords. Under the mental domination of Il-Vanda, she proclaimed the emperor's title and changed the nation's name to the Grimzak Empire. Then, to capture the leaders of light, the key to the revival of the sealed Dark God Dernisoth, she bared her fangs against the forces of light."}
en: In the year 2363 of the Continental Calendar, Arturia succeeded in breaking the seals on the Four Demon Lords. Under the mental domination of Il-Vanda, she proclaimed the emperor's title and changed the nation's name to the Grimzak Empire. Then, to capture the leaders of light, the key to the revival of the sealed Dark God Dernisoth, she bared her fangs against the forces of light.
en2: In 2363 AC, Arturia freed the Four Demon Lords. Controlled by Il-Vanda, she founded the Grimzak Empire. To revive the sealed Dark God Dernisoth, she targeted the Leaders of Light.
